description: Ten questions that check real understanding of Homer. Answers included so you can self-test.
key_points: Q: What is Homer known for? A: Iliad, Odyssey
Q: What field did Homer work in? A: epic poetry

demo.program:
# Homer — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Homer known for?", "Iliad, Odyssey"),
    ("What field did Homer work in?", "epic poetry"),
    ("What is lived?", "c. 8th century BC"),
    ("What is field?", "epic poetry"),
    ("What is known for?", "Iliad, Odyssey"),
    ("What is note?", "The fountainhead of Western literature"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
